platforms.description: Triumph 250cc DOHC four-stroke family (MX, cross-country, enduro) sharing engine/chassis; Pro-X lists one piston for all
Triumph 450cc four-stroke family; RC Edition launched 2025, X/C/E for 2026

products.variants: Titanium head pipe/mid pipe/canister, carbon end cap; blemished/refurb version also sold by Cycle Gear
products.what_it_changes: Pro Circuit says it improves performance across the rpm range; RC-4 resonance chamber, removable USFS spark arrestor. Meets AMA amateur sound limits, not FIM pro limits (per retailer copy).
products.caveats: Pro Circuit site not fetched; part number taken from Cycle Gear 'Manufacturer Product #'. MXA (2025 spotlight) quoted $1,269.95 for 2025 TF250X.

products.product: Ti-6 Pro Titanium Exhaust System (Triumph TF250X)
products.variants: Titanium with carbon end cap; Pro RC-4 titanium head pipe
products.what_it_changes: Retailer copy says it passes AMA/FIM sound rules, is lighter than stock and improves throttle response; closed-course only.
products.caveats: Pro Circuit site not fetched; part number taken from Cycle Gear 'Manufacturer Product #'. No dB figure published.

products.variants: Stainless head/mid pipe and end cap, aluminum canister
products.what_it_changes: Budget stainless alternative to Ti-6; Pro Circuit claims same performance as Ti-6 with more durability.
products.caveats: Pro Circuit site not fetched; part number taken from Cycle Gear 'Manufacturer Product #'. MXA quoted $990.95 in its 2025 spotlight. A T-6 slip-on for TF250X is also listed on RevZilla (https://www.revzilla.com/dirt-bike/pro-circuit-t-6-slip-on-exhaust-triumph-tf250x) - not fetched.

products.product: Ti-6 Pro Titanium Exhaust System (Triumph TF450C / TF450RC)
products.variants: Titanium, carbon end cap, RC-4 Ti head pipe
products.what_it_changes: Built for pro AMA racing; passes AMA/FIM sound rules per retailer copy; lighter than stock.
products.caveats: Pro Circuit site not fetched; part number taken from Cycle Gear 'Manufacturer Product #'. TF 450-X / TF 450-E 2026 not listed - confirm with Pro Circuit.

products.product: Ti-6 BC Pro Exhaust System (Triumph TF450C / TF450RC)
products.variants: All-titanium incl. end cap; 'BC' not defined by seller
products.what_it_changes: Passes AMA/FIM sound; machined mid-pipe joint for leak-free fit (retailer copy).
products.caveats: Pro Circuit site not fetched; part number taken from Cycle Gear 'Manufacturer Product #'. Meaning of 'BC' unknown. RevZilla photo shows a Yamaha.

products.variants: Stainless with aluminum canister
products.what_it_changes: Economical stainless system; Pro Circuit says same performance as Ti-6; AMA amateur sound compliant; USFS spark arrestor.
products.caveats: Pro Circuit site not fetched; part number taken from Cycle Gear 'Manufacturer Product #'. Seller URL has typo 'TC450C'.

products.variants: Titanium anodized w/ carbon cap (045695); Cycle Gear also lists Stainless/Aluminum/Carbon option (FMF number not shown)
products.what_it_changes: FMF claims power gains through the rpm range and weight savings; RTS tuning, removable spark arrestor, 94 dB quiet insert; works with stock or FMF header.
products.supporting_parts: Uses stock header or FMF header.
products.caveats: Cycle Gear 'from' price depends on material. FMF's own page for 045695 not fetched.

products.variants: Stainless pipe, grey anodized aluminum body, carbon cap

fits.notes: Ghost Bikes lists 2025 and 2026 RC Edition

products.what_it_changes: RCT core said to lower dB while keeping power; QuietCore 94 dB insert and spark arrestor included.
products.caveats: Seller notes it will NOT pass 2025 FIM sound regulation. Sold out at check.

Drop-in friction pack.

products.caveats: Part number read from image filename on Rekluse blog - verify.

products.caveats: PNs from image filenames; Triumph fitment of generic brake parts not confirmed.

products.variants: Material options (out of stock at check)

products.product: FSC Clutch Fiber/Steel/Spring Kit (Triumph TF 450-RC Edition)
products.what_it_changes: Fibers, steels and stiffer-than-stock springs.

rider_feedback.author: Kris Keefer
rider_feedback.summary: Firmer pull but more bite and engagement feel; better low-mid pull and recovery; outlasts OEM plates (OEM ~10 h for him). Recommends as early mod.
rider_feedback.conditions: Hard MX use, incl. soft dirt

products.caveats: Price as quoted in review, April 2025.

products.what_it_changes: Re-springs KYB AOS coil fork for rider weight.
products.supporting_parts: Check OEM rate in owner's manual.
products.caveats: No per-rate FC part numbers; only 2024 TF250X listed.

products.variants: Black; 22mm fixed offset

fits.notes: Keefer tested on TF-250-X and TF-450 RC

products.what_it_changes: Split clamps, rounder clamping under load, more anti-rotation (maker). Keefer: stiffer than stock, better flat-corner stability.
products.supporting_parts: Requires X-Trig PHDS or Fix bar mount.

rider_feedback.author: Kris Keefer
rider_feedback.summary: Stiffer than stock but keeps bump absorption; more front-end stability through flat corners, less wallow; no fork slip at normal torque specs. Price quoted $800.
rider_feedback.conditions: MX test on TF-250-X / TF-450 RC

products.caveats: X-Trig part number not found. Triumph also lists an XTrig holeshot device as a dealer accessory.

products.product: PHDS Progressive Handlebar Dampening System (Triumph TF)
products.variants: Spacers 3/5/10mm; Technical Touch soft/firm elastomers available
products.what_it_changes: Rubber-damped bar mounts; reduce vibration.
products.supporting_parts: Required with ROCS Tech clamps (or Fix mount).

rider_feedback.author: Kris Keefer
rider_feedback.summary: Noticeably less vibration than stock, especially high rpm; heavier than stock.

products.caveats: Approximate price ('almost $200'); no PN.
